g.text: (b) Numpy network 8-32-6 on synthetic 8-band pixels. Each of 10 satellites holds 600 pixels with its own class mix (Dirichlet, alpha = 0.3: one may
see mostly ocean, another desert). Each round every satellite trains 2 epochs from the global model; updates are averaged by sample count. Test: 6 000
pixels with all classes equally likely.
